text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion triumphs in the Mile CS! 
Though clearly disappointed, Kawakami 
Princess congratulates her as a rival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thunderous applause and cheers echoed from 
the stands. No one would ever forget the 
victor of this dazzling clash of 
princesses...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having finished an incredible race, Fine 
Motion shares a laugh with her Trainer 
about what to do tomorrow. Only a few 
months left until she returns home. 
There's still time...!
